correctness.rationale: All graph, edge support, self-loop, normalization, dimension, and spectral quantifiers are explicit. Automorphism averaging is valid by convexity of the centered operator norm; tensor eigenvalues have correct multiplicities; two independent scalar lower bounds meet the feasible all-equal-coordinate-scaled solution. Rigidity uses PSD equality on every saturated coordinate eigenspace, forcing each complete-graph fiber Laplacian t(I-J/q) and all individual edges. Reconstructed this proof with boundary tS=1 and equal-bound cases. verify.py produced 31124 rational, spectral, LP and non-invariant finite checks; they corroborate rather than prove the all-dimensional theorem.

value.rationale: A natural heterogeneous-coordinate mixing design is classified completely despite unconstrained individual symmetric edge weights. The all-optima rigidity assertion is structural, beyond merely specifying a symmetric average; the holding/no-holding arithmetic boundary and the invariance of the optimum on K2^(d-1) × K_q for arbitrarily large q are exact and operationally useful. This is not an arbitrary small parameter sample or restatement of equal-alphabet Hamming formulas.
